content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-212. - Penalty.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate a provision of this article. Violators
               shall be subject to the penalties provided by
section 1-5
. A separate offense shall be deemed committed upon each day such person is in violation
               of this article.
(Code 1981, § 23-12;…
